spec.description:
Hushtec Acoustic Barriers (Performance Series & Premium Series)
are high-performance modular outdoor and indoor noise control panels engineered
to mitigate noise pollution on construction, demolition, civil infrastructure,
and industrial worksites. Built with an advanced multi-layered acoustic
composite core combining dense sound-blocking mass with sound-absorbing porous
media, they achieve noise reductions of up to 43 dB. Equipped with heavy-duty
tensioned brass eyelets and hook-and-loop Velcro joins, they attach rapidly to
temporary fencing, scaffolding, and hoarding structures.
features: Multi-layered acoustic composite engineered for up to 43 dB sound reduction

Heavy-duty hook-and-loop Velcro overlap connections eliminate acoustic flanking
leakage

Reinforced perimeter eyelets for fast attachment to temporary fencing
and scaffolding

All-weather UV-resistant and waterproof exterior PVC/polymer
outer facing

Dual-function noise attenuation: sound-blocking mass layer
combined with acoustic absorption

Contains dust, debris, and airborne
particulate spread on construction sites

Fully portable, reusable, and
transferable across multiple project sites

Self-extinguishing fire-rated
construction compliant with worksite safety standards

Tested in accordance
with international acoustic transmission loss standards (ASTM / ISO)

technical.value:

spec.fire:
Fire-retardant, self-extinguishing construction compliant with commercial
construction site safety standards
spec.compliance:
Tested to ISO 10140 / ASTM
E90 acoustic transmission loss standards, AS/NZS worksite standards
spec.sustainability:
Reusable multi-project lifespan; recyclable synthetic
polymers; non-toxic
install:
Erect stable temporary fencing, scaffolding,
or structural site hoarding

Position Hushtec panels vertically against the
fence with acoustic absorbing side facing the noise source

Secure panels
through reinforced perimeter eyelets using heavy-duty elastic bungees or zip
ties

Overlap adjacent panel edges and press the integrated Velcro sealing
flaps firmly together

Ensure zero gaps exist at panel joins, corners, or
ground level to prevent acoustic flanking

Secure bottom eyelets close to the
ground to block sound escaping underneath
selection_checklist:
Confirm
noise source decibel level and required reduction (Performance up to 34 dB vs
Premium up to 43 dB)

Measure linear meterage and height of perimeter fencing
or scaffolding

Verify fence structural capacity to support panel wind load
and dead weight

Confirm connection accessories (elastic bungees, cable ties,
or scaffold clamps)
limitations:
Designed for temporary site fencing, scaffolding, and equipment enclosures; not
a permanent building wall batt

Temporary fencing must be adequately weighted
with counterweights to withstand wind loads

Avoid puncturing the acoustic
composite skin during handling
spec.warranty:
Standard manufacturer warranty
backed by Hushtec

use_cases:
Hanging on temporary fencing around civil construction
and demolition sites to protect nearby residents

Wrapping scaffolding to
contain noisy power tools and dust during facade refurbishments

Creating
mobile acoustic enclosures around noisy diesel generators, concrete saws, and
compressors
not_for:
Internal building cavity wall insulation (use bulk
batts)
